WITH cd_filtered AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')
),
wr_agg AS (
    SELECT wr_item_sk,
           wr_order_number,
           wr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
           wr_returning_cdemo_sk,
           wr_refunded_addr_sk,
           wr_reason_sk,
           SUM(wr_refunded_cash) AS wr_refunded_cash,
           SUM(wr_fee) AS wr_fee
    FROM web_returns
    GROUP BY wr_item_sk, wr_order_number, wr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
             wr_returning_cdemo_sk, wr_refunded_addr_sk, wr_reason_sk
),
ws_sel AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk,
           ws_order_number,
           ws_web_page_sk,
           ws_sold_date_sk,
           ws_quantity,
           ws_sales_price,
           ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
      AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
),
reason_filtered AS (
    SELECT rr.r_reason_sk, rr.r_reason_desc
    FROM reason AS rr
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_returns wr WHERE wr.wr_reason_sk = rr.r_reason_sk)
)
SELECT SUBSTR(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
       AVG(ws.ws_quantity),
       AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
       AVG(wr.wr_fee)
FROM customer_address AS ca
JOIN wr_agg AS wr
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
   AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
   AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
JOIN cd_filtered AS cd1
    ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN cd_filtered AS cd2
    ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
JOIN ws_sel AS ws
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
   AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN web_page AS wp
    ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d
    ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
   AND d.d_year = 1998
JOIN reason_filtered AS r
    ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
WHERE cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
  AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
  AND (
        (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D'
         AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
         AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
     OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S'
         AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College'
         AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
     OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U'
         AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
         AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
      )
  AND (
        (ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
     OR (ca.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
     OR (ca.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
      )
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY SUBSTR(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20), AVG(ws.ws_quantity), AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
